Portuguese federation provisionally suspends Ronaldo after national team walkout

Cristiano Ronaldo, the 41‑year‑old Portugal striker, was provisionally suspended by the Portuguese Football Federation after he left the national team camp in Copenhagen during Nations League preparations, following a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus; Ronaldo had earlier apologised to supporters and said he would accept any sanction, and the federation opened disciplinary proceedings that could result in a ban of one to six months, noting he was an unused substitute in the recent match against Norway.
